role: The first-person held item and arm: renders the item in hand (block as a 3D item, sprite as an extruded 2D quad), the eat/drink/bow/block use animations, the swing and equip motions, and the screen overlays (inside-block texture, water warp, fire).
scope_reason: The hand and the first-person overlays are part of every frame the agent sees; the native hand path reproduces them from the same state.

members.name: static constants (RES_ITEM_GLINT, RES_MAP_BACKGROUND, RES_UNDERWATER_OVERLAY, __OBFID)
members.note: RES_MAP_BACKGROUND and the glint belong to the unported held-map and glint branches; the underwater texture path is resolved by the C asset reader

members.name: mc
members.note: the C hand pass reads play.c's client state

members.name: itemToRender
members.note: play.c's equip struct: item, damage, present, and the surv_stack gen standing in for == identity

members.name: renderBlocksIr
members.note: the held block drawn through block_item_model's cube geometry

members.name: renderItem
members.note: third person through raster_things.c, first person through raster_hand.c, both with the glint

members.name: renderItemIn2D
members.note: front and back faces plus the four extruded edge strips

members.name: renderItemInFirstPerson
members.note: the eat/drink, bow pull, sword block, swing and equip animations, the bare arm, the two render passes (the potion's overlay and bottle, the second under GL_LEQUAL) and the enchant glint on the tick clock (idx-glint-s1 25 to 57 within 18 px). The filled_map branch is unreachable: maps = off (world.conf) makes ItemEmptyMap.onItemRightClick return first (ItemEmptyMap.java:23), and no loot or trade holds a filled map (the stronghold library's Items.map is the empty one)

members.name: renderWarpedTextureOverlay
members.note: the yaw/64, pitch/64 UV scroll at the player's brightness

members.name: renderFireInFirstPerson
members.note: two rotated quads of the fire layer sprite at alpha 0.9

members.name: updateEquippedItem
members.note: the same-item/damage identity shortcut uses the stack gen instead of reference ==

members.name: resetEquippedProgress
members.note: player.h's equip_reset flag is consumed at the top of equip_tick

notes: The hand camera (renderstate.c:renderstate_hand_camera) reproduces renderHand's getFOVModifier(pt,false) projection and the hurt/bob modelview before this class's transforms. draw_hand in csrc/play/play.c wires the equip state, the swing progress and the light value into raster_hand_draw. The hand scenes are pixel-gated by csrc/tests/test_render.c against the oracle goldens. lane/idxclient: closed: the glint and the multi-pass hand are drawn and judged (idx-glint-s1); the held map is unreachable with maps off. lane/idxclient (later): renderFireInFirstPerson reads the client player's isBurning: its own fire (moveEntity's touch of fire or lava this tick) or the server's flag byte, which the server now sets where Entity.onEntityUpdate does and the tracker pass sends (PK_S1C_FLAGS); it had read a field nothing wrote (idx-deathmsg-s1 426: 32,090 px to 2,884).
